# Travis CI node

Use the Travis CI node to automate work in Travis CI, and integrate Travis CI with other applications. n8n has built-in support for a wide range of Travis CI features, including cancelling and getting builds.

On this page, you'll find a list of operations the Travis CI node supports and links to more resources.

**Credentials**

Refer to [Travis CI credentials](../credentials/travisci.md) for guidance on setting up authentication.

## Operations

* Build
    * Cancel a build
    * Get a build
    * Get all builds
    * Restart a build
    * Trigger a build

## Templates and examples

[Browse Travis CI node documentation integration templates](https://n8n.io/integrations/travisci) or [search all templates](https://n8n.io/workflows/)
